summary: You can see at a glance what your tenant still needs before the suite works fully.

new.title: Get started shows what is missing
new.text: A new Get started page lists the 13 things the suite needs, such as permissions, break-glass accounts, groups and named locations. Check now reads your tenant, changes nothing, and marks each ready or missing.

new.title: Manage break-glass accounts on the page
new.text: A SuperAdmin can now add and change the break-glass accounts list on Get started. It changes the suite's list only, never your tenant.

new.title: Invardia sees whether setup is complete
new.text: For installs that report to Invardia, the status report now says whether every one-time setup step is in place, checked fresh each time.
